faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for Executive Level Posts in the Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2026. These positions are distributed across various engineering and accounting roles within the organization.

faq.question: Q2. What are the important dates for applying to Cochin Port Authority Executive Level Posts?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 10 July 2026, and the last date to apply and submit the application fee is 10 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they apply within this window.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General/OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500. However, candidates belonging to SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these Executive Level Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Executive Level Posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms, including 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes a Computer Based Test (Objective type) followed by an Interview. Candidates must qualify in both stages to be considered for final selection.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Asst. Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Desirable experience includes two years in an executive cadre in relevant fields, preferably in Port and Marine Structures.

faq.question: Q7. Can SC/ST candidates apply without paying any fee?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to the SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee for the Cochin Port Authority Executive Level Posts recruitment. They only need to complete the online application form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for Executive Level Posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Executive Level Posts ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month, depending on the specific post. Higher-level executive posts offer a salary of Rs. 50,000-1,60,000.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of Cochin Port Authority. The application link will be active from 10 July 2026. Ensure all details are filled correctly and documents are uploaded as specified.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, PwBD candidates are eligible for age relaxation of 10 years. This relaxation extends to 15 years for PwBD (SC/ST) and 13 years for PwBD (OBC) candidates, as per government guidelines.
